core_obligations: Reduce full faithfulness to the colimit identity colim P tensor_{A,F^N} A = colim P tensor_{A,F^N} A/J x colim P tensor_{A,F^N} A/fA over colim P tensor_{A,F^N} A/(fA + J) for a finite projective A-module P, then to P finite free, then to P = A, where it is the fibre-product statement for the structure sheaf (proof lines 12250-12264).

Turn essential surjectivity into the algebra problem for P_1 finite projective over A/J, P_2 finite projective over A/fA and an isomorphism after inverting f and killing J, and solve it by producing a finite projective module over A/(J cap fA) through the fibre-product identity A/(J cap fA) = A/J x_{A/(fA+J)} A/fA (proof lines 12267-12291).

Use that J is finitely generated and f-power torsion so that J cap fA is nilpotent, hence the map A -> A/(J cap fA) factors the Frobenius power F^N for some N, and set P = P' tensor_{A/(J cap fA), beta} A to obtain the compatible isomorphisms in the F-periodic category (proof lines 12292-12299).
proof_roadmap: Full faithfulness: reduce to finite free P and then to P = A, quoting the structure sheaf fibre-product computation (proof lines 12250-12264).
Essential surjectivity: formulate the descent problem for a pair of finite projective modules and solve it over the fibre product A/(J cap fA) (proof lines 12267-12291).
Descend the solution along the nilpotent ideal J cap fA by factoring the Frobenius twist (proof lines 12292-12299).
difficulty_reason: In characteristic p, for the almost blowup square X, X', Z, E attached to one equation f, the lemma states that the functor from F-periodic vector bundles on X to compatible pairs on Z and X' is an equivalence (statement lines 12234-12247). The proof is an algebraisation of the geometry: because all schemes are affine and vector bundles have internal Hom, full faithfulness reduces to the identity colim P tensor_{A, F^N} A = colim P tensor_{A,F^N} A/J x_{colim P tensor A/(fA+J)} colim P tensor_{A,F^N} A/fA for a finite projective A-module P, which is reduced to P finite free, then to P = A, and finally quoted from the fibre-product computation for the structure sheaf (proof lines 12250-12264). Essential surjectivity is turned into an explicit descent problem: given finite projective P_1 over A/J and P_2 over A/fA agreeing after inverting f and killing J, one uses the fibre-product identity A/(J cap fA) = A/J x_{A/(fA+J)} A/fA, the finitely-presented-module-over-a-fibre-product lemma, and the nilpotence of J cap fA to produce N and a finite projective A-module P with the required compatible isomorphisms (proof lines 12267-12299). Recognising that the Frobenius twist is exactly what makes the nilpotent thickening descend is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
